text: OMV Aktiengesellschaft holds a 51.2% stake in OMV Petrom and is its majority shareholder.

source.name: OMV Petrom: Shareholder Information (omvpetrom.com)
source.quote: OMV Aktiengesellschaft, one of the largest listed industrial companies in Austria, holds a 51.2% stake in OMV Petrom.
source.note: Undated investor page; the stake is stated as at end-2025. Date is the day the page was opened.

additionalSources.name: OMV: Capital Market Story, May 2025 (PDF)
additionalSources.quote: OMV Petrom - listed on BSE, fully consolidated − OMV share 51%
additionalSources.note: OMV Aktiengesellschaft's own investor presentation, under 'Stock listed participations'.
